question: Who among the following became the MP from Azamgarh constituency, Uttar Pradesh in June 2022 by defeating Dharmendra Yadav?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dinesh Lal Yadav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dinesh Lal Yadav:**

 
 
• Born on February 2, 1979, Dinesh Lal Yadav is an Indian actor, singer, producer, and politician who is mostly connected with Bhojpuri-language films.
 
• He is also known by the nickname **Nirahua**, which means "an abiding husband." 
 
• **On March 27, 2019, Nirahua entered politics by joining the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Lucknow.**
